key_insight: Jianmu-Q uses coordinated AI agents to convert natural-language quantum field theory descriptions into validated quantum simulation workflows spanning theory, discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design.
engineering_relevance: The framework lowers the translation burden between continuum field theory and quantum hardware, enabling more reproducible end-to-end quantum software pipelines for scientific computing.
method: Specialized agents handle theoretical formulation, lattice discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit synthesis.
Physical-consistency checks and independent numerical calculations validate each stage of the workflow.
Benchmarked on the (1+1)D Nambu--Jona-Lasinio and Schwinger models plus a (2+1)D Z2 gauge theory.
evidence_signal: Across three benchmark field theories, noiseless circuit simulations matched independent exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results, and selected circuits were run on IBM hardware.
watch_item: The approach still depends on accurate agent coordination and validation, and hardware runs remain constrained by present-day quantum device noise and scale limits.
paper_title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
